title: You can keep the hoodie
old_caption: Scorpio handed over the hoodie and claimed not to be cold. Day 3, day 19, day 64, still Libra's. By day 200 it's two faces in one hood. What did they never get back from you?

title: I made you a plate
old_caption: Aries got home at 9:48, found an empty pot, an empty pan and one lemon. Then Cancer slid over a warm plate arranged as a smiley face. And a dessert plate. Tag your plate maker.

title: Aquarius explaining a theory about the moon to the date
old_caption: Nobody: Aquarius on a first date, wheeling in a chalkboard to explain that the moon only shows one side because it's shy. The date leaned in and asked if it blushes. Perfect match?

title: Cancer saving every voice note in a little labeled shell box
old_caption: One voice note and Cancer has opened an archive: box one is 'night!', then the laugh, the sneeze (cute), the humming. Established Tuesday. Sentimental? Archival. What would you never delete?

title: Capricorn making a color-coded calendar of date ideas
old_caption: Nobody: Capricorn planning date night with 9:00 to 9:05 scheduled as spontaneous fun, including a natural gasp at 9:01. Their date read it and was charmed. Who's this planner in your life?

title: Gemini at 2 AM starting three new hobbies for us
old_caption: 2 AM, partner asleep, and Gemini has already started the ukulele, the sourdough and a bike built for two. The twist: Libra wakes up ready to join. Who's your 2 AM idea person?

title: Pisces crying at a pixel commercial about socks
old_caption: Nobody: Pisces watching an ad about two socks finding each other. Taurus, eyes never leaving the screen, hands over one tissue, then another, then the whole box. Who passes you the tissues?

title: Just got into astrology pack
old_caption: A laminated chart wheel, sudden opinions about everything, calling a sandwich 'so Gemini', and asking the actual Moon its moon sign. Which item in the pack are you?

title: Homebody in love pack
old_caption: Homebody in love starter pack: a load-bearing blanket, tea always, a party hat for when plans get cancelled. Rare item: a date on the same couch. Who's your couch person?

title: The friend who's always matchmaking pack
old_caption: Matchmaker friend starter pack: a clipboard, two names in a heart, a fake 'oh wow, small world' from behind a bush. Rare item: their own crush walking by. Tag your matchmaker.
